Name: (FF) Tub o' Flowers Color Varieties
Author: SchrodingersKit
Description:
More color varieties of Tub o' Flowers to decorate your farm--now for Furniture Framework! Mix and match sixteen colors~
Huge thanks to [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/68147882-angelofstars/]AngelOfStars[/url] for the conversion, as well as the additional wood finishes!

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1934]For the Content Patcher version, go here![/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25053]For the Alternative Textures version, go here![/url]

There are two optional wood packs to expand with, under optional files--
[b]Burnt Sienna,[/b] to match my Burnt Sienna Craftables set
[b]AngelOfStars woods-[/b] comes in 4 colors: Walnut, Spruce, Mahogany, and Ebony!

Any more flower colors or wood finishes you'd like to see? Leave a comment on this mod, or send me a DM and I'll make an update!

To install--
1. Install the latest versions of SMAPI, Content Patcher, and Furniture Framework.﻿
2. Unzip and paste into your 'Mods' folder.
3. Load up your game and enjoy! You will find the new Tubs of Flowers in the [b]Furniture Catalog. [/b]
